summary: Re-tested all 6 onboarding scenarios on Expo web preview (mobile viewport 375x667) after the OnboardingContext fix. ALL SCENARIOS PASS: (1) Fresh user with cleared localStorage lands on onboarding slide 1 showing 'WELCOME TO' eyebrow. (2) Tapping onboarding-next 3x reaches slide 4 with CTA label 'Open Recall'; a 4th tap navigates to Inbox (capture-button visible, URL = /, onboarding-next removed from DOM). (3) Reload without clearing storage keeps user on Inbox. (4) Skip flow from a fresh state lands directly on Inbox. (5) In Settings, tapping replay-onboarding returns to onboarding slide 1 (eyebrow 'WELCOME TO' visible). (6) After replay, 4 Next taps re-land on Inbox. Zero matches for /warnOfExpoGoPushUsage/i and zero uncaught/pageerror events across all flows. The reactive OnboardingContext setter correctly keeps gate state in sync with programmatic transitions.
critical_code_review_comments: OnboardingContext in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx now exposes setOnboarded via useMemo'd value — correct reactive pattern. The gate's redirect effect depends on `onboarded` state, so callers (onboarding.tsx and settings.tsx) updating via setOnboarded causes the gate to react on the next render. Verified in-browser.

Minor: /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx imports useOnboarding from '@/app/_layout' which creates a cross-import between a route file and the layout — functional but slightly unusual. Consider extracting OnboardingContext into /app/frontend/src/onboarding/context.ts for cleaner separation. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. Used window.localStorage.clear() between scenarios to simulate first-time user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding gate is now fully reactive via OnboardingContext.setOnboarded. All 6 scenarios from iteration_7 action items are verified green at https://compose-saver.preview.emergentagent.com. No further onboarding-related work needed; proceed with other features.
rca_of_issue: Fix in iteration_8 confirmed: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx now exposes `OnboardingContext` with `{onboarded, setOnboarded}` via useMemo. /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx::finish() calls `setOnboarded(true)` after markOnboarded() and before router.replace('/'), causing the gate's effect to see the updated state and NOT bounce back. /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx::replay-onboarding Pressable removes the AsyncStorage key, calls `setOnboarded(false)`, then router.replace('/onboarding'), so the gate does not redirect back to '/'. Previous stale-state redirect-loop is resolved.
